direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only; main split into independent reserved zones with no overlap: rendered cinematic scene at least 70% of main width, plus callout, station and job zones inside the scene, and a condensed side zone for evidence without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible routes, state glow on changed nodes, layered depth in the factory scene and 160-220ms ease-out selection transitions; one 240ms cinematic route trace on real state change; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left, large tabs spanning most of the header, Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls, never conflating them; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald with animated flow, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; depth via layered machine forms, soft emerald glow on active flow, silver shading on idle forms

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and give Receiving, cells and jobs distinct depth, material flow and state glow so the held lot reads cinematically at 1366x768.
Add a persistent legend for Held, Available and Feasible inside the scene zone, with x marker and text labels, without shrinking 16px body type.
Raise dim silver secondary text contrast and add a visible 2px emerald focus ring to Source detail and the primary action.
Separate connection readiness for provider identity from the investigation evidence task into two headed blocks with independent status and controls in the side zone.
Reduce the empty lower side zone by enlarging verified findings metrics to 26px tabular figures and linking each finding bidirectionally to its SVG node.
Trim sample narration to one instruction and one status sentence so Continue to compare paths remains the single clear primary.
On selecting a path, surface one-click Approve followed by the Authorize this decision wall, keeping Review recovery option as the pre-selection label only.
Animate the chosen feasible route in emerald through the SVG with a single 240ms trace and matching glow on the selected comparison row.
Enlarge the three Select this path targets to at least 44px height while keeping 16px labels and equal visual weight.
Add living flow from Receiving through CELL-MILL-1 to the proposed task cards, with t1 glow on selection and dashed silver treatment for untracked t2 and t3.
Make the board task numbers keyboard reachable in sequence with focus ring and aria-current on the active task, mirrored in the scene zone.
Compress duplicate proposal status wording so Approve The Britt's proposal and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL each appear once per zone.
Strengthen the previewed stopped state: full silver cross-hatching, large x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text on CELL-MILL-2, with its route visibly terminated and no emerald flow through it.
Add a cinematic depth shift when previewing 24h to 0h, dimming downstream jobs while the feasible CELL-MILL-1 route keeps emerald flow.
Keep Scenario management visually subordinate and separated from the machine selector so Apply second shock stays the only primary.
Make the OFFLINE cross-hatching, x marker and OFFLINE label larger and higher contrast, and remove any route line entering CELL-MILL-2.
Fill the empty findings zone with a compact pre-investigation state: separate provider identity readiness status above, and evidence task status below, each with its own control.
Show 3 to 2 feasible paths as animated rerouting around the stopped cell, static under reduced motion, before Reinvestigate recovery is pressed.
Apply the same hatched x-marked OFFLINE treatment to the constrained Split option in the scene strip as in the comparison panel for consistent state language.
Highlight the two remaining feasible routes with emerald flow and glow linked to their comparison rows on hover, focus and selection.
On selection, open one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall, replacing the generic review wording after a path is chosen.
Visually separate the 3 BLOCKED prior tasks in a hatched silver zone below the proposed replacements while keeping the approved recovery plan banner present, so both states clearly coexist.
Add state glow and flow to t1 as the ready replacement, keeping all three proposed tasks plainly UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL until Approve revised tasks is used.
Mirror blocked and proposed task selection bidirectionally between scene cards and the side board with focus ring and aria-live status.
Give the 01 02 03 proof cards cinematic depth: emerald glow only on READY Verify ledger, dashed silver and plain LOCKED text on the later stages.
Condense the side evidence panel inside its reserved zone at 16px body so Verify, Seal and Retain statuses are all visible at 1366x768 without inspector scrolling.
Add keyboard order and focus rings across the three stage cards matching the side checklist sequence, with aria-live confirmation after Verify ledger.

After Trigger failure, animate the cascade as emerald flow stopping department by department, with affected machines switching to held silver or hatched x-marked OFFLINE text states by real selection.
Add depth and glow to the isometric machine forms so Running reads as living material movement, while idle departments stay brushed silver and static under reduced motion.
Fix the overlapping sample caption over the metric cards by moving it into the reserved instruction row, keeping 16px type and equal-width department zones.

Preserve the required opening logo placement at native aspect and enlarge the live demo link target, keeping the specified presentation order: disruption, investigation, human approval, second shock, proof.
Refit the embedded full-shop image so every department label and machine state is legible at judge viewing size, with a caption tying failure then recovery to the live cascade.
Tighten partner and model sections into a scannable 16px table that separates provider identity and serving role from the investigation and decision roles.
